title: ItemLeveler
description:
Upgrading tools according to their use
A plug-in that is easy to edit 
That greatly enhances the server level
body:
🌟 ItemLeveler | The Ultimate RPG Item Progression & Leveling System 🌟
Give your players a reason to grind and cherish their hard-earned gear! ItemLeveler is a premium-tier, high-performance progression plugin that brings an immersive RPG leveling mechanic to your tools and weapons. As players mine blocks or slay monsters, their items gain XP, level up, change formats dynamically, and unlock permanent custom attributes!

Built from the ground up for modern Minecraft servers, it features strict anti-dupe and anti-exploit protections, stunning visual feedback, and unique gameplay features.

🎯 Key Features
💎 Dynamic Multi-Attribute Progression
As tools or weapons level up, they automatically unlock real Minecraft attribute modifiers (e.g., Mining Efficiency, Block Fortune, Attack Damage). You can bind multiple attributes to a single level or create completely unique progression paths.

⚡ Lucky Multiplier Event (Critical XP Boosters)
Keep gameplay exciting! Every action has a random chance to trigger a temporary Lucky XP Multiplier. When triggered, a live countdown timer appears on the player's Action Bar (e.g., 🔥 2x BOOST ACTIVE! 12s left), making them scramble to maximize their XP gains before time runs out!

🔮 Soulbound Protection (High-Tier Item Saving)
Protect your players' intense grinding. You can configure specific high-level items to become Soulbound. If a player dies with a Soulbound item, it will not drop on the ground or burn in lava—it safely stays in their inventory upon respawn!

🛑 Advanced Anti-Exploit Engines
Say goodbye to cheaters. The plugin includes a built-in tracking database:

Anti-Block Place Dupe: Blocks placed by players are flagged and will never grant XP when broken.

Anti-Spawner Farm Abuse: Monsters spawned from Mob Spawners are detected instantly and will never grant XP when killed.

📊 Beautiful Graphic Progress Bars & Lore
Items feature a premium visual UI right in their lore. Watch a sleek progress bar fill up dynamically as you use the tool. Max-level tools display a glorious custom status.

🛠️ Full Admin Control (OP Commands)
Easily integrate the leveling system with your server webstore, crates, or quests! Admins can forcefully set item levels or give custom XP to any player's held item, which automatically scales all attributes and re-syncs the NBT data seamlessly.

⚙️ 100% Fully Customizable Configuration
⚠️ Everything is completely configurable! You have total control over the plugin's behavior, visuals, and values through a clean, well-documented config.yml.

Custom Lore Layouts: Move, edit, or completely redesign the item lore using placeholders like %level%, %progress_text%, and %progress_bar_visual%.

Tailored Level Trees: Define exactly how many levels exist, the XP required for each tier, and custom prefix naming formats.

Tweakable Rates: Fully customize the Lucky Multiplier activation chance, the duration of the boost, and the exact multiplier value.

Sound & Particle Engine: Change or disable the Spigot sounds and particle effects that burst when an item levels up.

Full Translation Support: Every text component, chat message, prefix, and action bar announcement supports full color codes (&) and can be translated to any language.

💻 Commands & Permissions
/itemleveler setlevel <player> <level> (Alias: /il setlevel)

Description: Forcefully sets the held item's level, accurately simulating its XP value and reapplying all corresponding attributes and lore.

Permission: itemleveler.admin (Defaults to OP)

📄 Default config.yml Preview
YAML
settings:
  effects:
    enable-sound: true
    sound-type: "ENTITY_PLAYER_LEVELUP"
    enable-particles: true
    particle-type: "HAPPY_VILLAGER"
  anti-exploit:
    ignore-player-placed-blocks: true
    ignore-spawner-mobs: true
  lucky-xp:
    enabled: true
    chance: 5
    multiplier: 2
    duration-seconds: 15
🚀 Installation Guide
Drop ItemLeveler.jar into your server's plugins folder.

Restart your server to generate the default configuration files.

Customize the config.yml to fit your server's economy and theme.

Run /reload or restart, and enjoy a premium RPG experience!
